Design System & Visual Constraints:
- Calm Civic Editorial design system: warm paper background (#F8F7F2 / #FAF9F5), forest ink typography (#183C32), deep primary (#256653), soft sage container fills (#E8EFE6 / #EEF4ED), hairline borders (#DDE4DA), Noto Sans body typography with multilingual Kannada and Hindi label subtitles/fallbacks, restrained Newsreader serif headlines, 8px spacing grid, 12px card border radius, minimum 48px tactile interactive touch targets/controls.
- Citizen-service civic reference interface, NOT a commercial SaaS dashboard. Absolutely NO photographs, NO illustrations, NO glossy gradients, NO fake governmental seals or unverified live data.
- Include the exact top civic disclaimer banner: "Design Reference & Future Specification Example — Not An Approved Live Application | 100% Anonymous: Zero PII Collected".
- Consistent header with MyGovGuide logo (open book / civic emblem), tagline "ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಸರಳ ಭಾಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ / Government Information, In Your Language", top navigation links (Home, Explore, Forms Library [Active], How It Works), language switcher pill (EN / ಕನ್ನಡ / हिंदी), notification icon, profile icon.

Forms Library Screen Specifics:
1. Breadcrumbs: Civic Repository / Forms & Procedural Checklists (ದಾಖಲೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅರ್ಜಿ ನಮೂನೆಗಳು)
2. Screen Headline & Subheading:
   - Editorial serif title: "Civic Forms & Official Procedures Library"
   - Bilingual subtitle in Kannada: "ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಅರ್ಜಿ ನಮೂನೆಗಳು, ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ ಸೂಚಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶೀಲನಾ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳು"
   - Clear advisory note: "All downloadable templates and portal links are referenced directly from Karnataka and Union Gazettes. MyGovGuide does NOT host third-party forms or store citizen data."
3. Comprehensive Search & Filter Controls (48px height controls):
   - Primary search input: "Search forms by scheme name, form number, or citizen category (e.g. Nadakacheri, PMUY, Caste & Income, Bonafide)..." with keyboard shortcut hint.
   - Filter Chips (tactile pills):
     * Format / Action Type: [All Resources] [Downloadable Blank PDF Forms] [Official Application Portals] [Procedural Checklists & Instructions]
     * Citizen Group / Domain: [Student & Education] [Farmer / Agrarian] [Social Welfare & Subsidies] [Women & Child Development] [Healthcare & Energy]
     * Verification Status: [Gazette Audited] [Pending Research Review]
4. Research Integrity / Middleman Alert Banner:
   - "Citizen Caution: Government application forms and Seva Sindhu submissions are strictly statutory and free from administrative surcharges. Never pay unauthorized intermediaries or cyber cafe agents for blank standard forms."
5. Primary Form & Portal Directory Grid / List:
   Distinctly categorized with high visual clarity separating "Downloadable PDF Document", "Authenticated Portal Only", and "Procedural Instruction Guide":

   A) PM Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) - Supplementary KYC Annexure-I:
      - TYPE BADGE: "Authenticated Portal Link Only" (Highlighted with clear external boundary styling).
      - Note: "In accordance with safety and oil marketing company (OMC) compliance rules, PMUY KYC applications cannot be submitted via mirror forms. Directs strictly to the official Union MoPNG / PMUY authenticated portal (pmuy.gov.in)."
      - Kannada translation: "ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್ ಲಿಂಕ್ ಮಾತ್ರ — ಮಧ್ಯವರ್ತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಹಣ ನೀಡಬೇಡಿ."
      - Metadata: Central Sector • Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas • Gazette Citation: GSR-341(E) • Review Status: Gazette Verified (Dec 2024).
      - Action: "Open Official PMUY Portal (External .gov.in) [Icon: External Link]" + "View Required Identity Checklist".

   B) Nadakacheri Atalji Janasnehi Kendra - 14-Digit Caste & Income Certificate (Form 1 / Form 2):
      - TYPE BADGE: "Downloadable Offline Reference PDF + Online Portal Guide".
      - Description: "Standard statutory affidavit and self-declaration format for Tahsildar revenue verification in Karnataka (Cat-1/2A/2B/3A/3B/SC/ST)."
      - Kannada title: "ಆದಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಜಾತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಪತ್ರ (ನಮೂನೆ ೧ / ೨) - ನಡಕಚೇರಿ".
      - Metadata: Karnataka Revenue Department • 3 Pages (A4) • Format: Fillable Offline PDF (Bilingual Kannada/English).
      - Status: "Gazette Verified • Active Template 2024-25".
      - Action: "Download Standard PDF (A4 420KB)" and "Track on Nadakacheri Portal".

   C) Karnataka Post-Matric Fee Concession - Institutional Bonafide & AISHE Verification Voucher:
      - TYPE BADGE: "Institutional Submission Template".
      - Description: "Affidavit template to be certified and stamped by College Principal/Institutional Nodal Officer (INO) citing AISHE code for SSP portal DBT disbursal."
      - Kannada: "ಕಾಲೇಜು ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಮತ್ತು ಬೋನಾಫೈಡ್ ದೃಢೀಕರಣ ನಮೂನೆ".
      - Metadata: Dept of Backward Classes Welfare • 1 Page PDF • Requires Principal Stamp.
      - Action: "Download Form PDF" + "Step-by-step INO Verification Guide".

   D) Seva Sindhu Citizen Services Protocol - Domicile & Continuous Residency Affidavit:
      - TYPE BADGE: "Procedural Checklist & Standard Draft".
      - Description: "Required format for proving 7+ years continuous residency in Karnataka when standard school records have gaps."
      - Metadata: Karnataka Dept of Personnel & Administrative Reforms • Status: "Research Material (Pending Departmental Review)".
      - Notice Badge: "Pending Review / ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಬಾಕಿ - Consult Local Tahsildar Office Before Submitting".
      - Action: "Inspect Research Draft & Checklist".

   E) Senior Citizen Card & Sandhya Suraksha Pension Sanction Form (Form 4):
      - TYPE BADGE: "Downloadable Blank Form".
      - Description: "Application for age-linked welfare grant, including Village Accountant enquiry schedule."
      - Metadata: Directorate of Social Security and Pensions, Karnataka.
      - Action: "Download Blank Form (Kannada & English)".

6. "How to Identify an Authentic Government Portal" Sidebar/Section:
   - Visual guidance card detailing:
     * Check for `.gov.in` or `.nic.in` domains (never `.com`, `.org`, or unofficial `.in` blogs).
     * HTTPS security lock with valid National Informatics Centre (NIC) certificate.
     * Absence of ad banners, paid fast-track buttons, or private UPI payment gateways.
     * Official state contact number (1902 Janaspandana helpline).
7. Consistent calm civic footer with Citizen Charter, Official Gazette Archive, Kannada Helpdesk, and zero PII privacy guarantee.

Civic Editorial","styleGuidelines":"## Brand & Style

This design system is crafted for public service delivery with a non-dashboard, high-dignity editorial disposition. It rejects the cold, telemetry-heavy aesthetics of SaaS dashboards and the flashy, deceptive patterns of consumer tech. Instead, it positions civic interactions as thoughtful, patient conversations rooted in archival permanence and clarity.

### Core Tenets
- **Civic Dignity & Calm:** The UI treats every interaction—whether checking pension eligibility, downloading a land record (Bhoomi/RTC), or filing a civic grievance—with stillness and respect.
- **Editorial Legibility:** Layouts follow reading-first publication paradigms rather than widget-dense cockpits. Information unfolds sequentially rather than clamoring for simultaneous attention.
- **Rooted & Tactile:** Replaces synthetic drop shadows, neon accents, and artificial gradients with physical metaphors of heavy rag paper, deliberate ink-weights, and quiet border lines.

### Visual Style
A hybrid of **Warm Editorial Publishing** and **Structured Public-Sector Functionalism**. Visual structures rely on warm bone/paper backgrounds, deep green-tinted ink lettering, sharp informational hierarchy, and hairline dividing rules that echo printed gazettes and citizen charters.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model is driven by vertical narrative flow rather than grid complexity. It models a sequential citizen desk or guidance manifesto.

### Spacing Engine
- Built on a strict **8px baseline unit** (`0.5rem = 8px`, `1rem = 16px`, `1.5rem = 24px`, `2rem = 32px`).
- Form elements, interactive cards, and action bars align vertically to this rhythm to ensure natural reading tempo.

### Breakpoints & Layout Composition
- **Mobile (`< 640px`):** Single conversational column. Screen margins are locked at `1rem` (16px). Stacked elements use `space-md` gaps. Sticky bottom action zones maintain accessibility within single-handed reach.
- **Tablet (`640px - 1024px`):** Centered narrative column capped at 680px width, flanked by contextual assistive notes (e.g., required paperwork reminders, office timings) in a quiet secondary column.
- **Desktop (`> 1024px`):** Maximum application width is strictly capped at `960px` centered. Avoiding wide edge-to-edge layouts prevents clinical dashboard fragmentation and keeps visual focus unified.

### Touch & Accessibility Standards
- All interactive controls (buttons, selection rows, dropdown toggles, language switchers) enforce a **hard minimum target height of 48px**, with 8px clearance from adjacent interactive boundaries.

## Elevation & Depth

This system intentionally rejects floating multi-tier drop shadows, 3D skeuomorphism, and blurred frosted glass. Depth is achieved via **tonal stratification and physical hairline framing**.

### Stacking Architecture
1. **Canvas Layer (`#F8F7F2`):** Base paper plane representing the public record space.
2. **Structural Surfaces (`#FFFFFF`):** Foreground cards and modules resting flat on the canvas, bounded by a 1px solid border in `#DDE4DA`.
3. **Elevated Sheet / Modal:** Used strictly for interactive dialogues or document inspection. Instead of generic black shadows, it uses a soft, warm contact shadow:
   `box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -2px rgba(24, 60, 50, 0.08), 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(24, 60, 50, 0.04);`
4. **Active/Focus Planes:** Visual priority is indicated through a 2px high-contrast inset or outset rule of `#256653`, not by raising the component toward the user.

## Components

### Buttons & Triggers
- **Primary Button:** Background `#256653`, text `#FFFFFF`, 0 border, minimum height 48px, horizontal padding `1.5rem`, border-radius 8px. Font: Noto Sans Medium (15px). Hover/Focus state: `#183C32`.
- **Secondary / Back Action:** Background transparent, text `#256653`, 1.5px border `#256653`. Never use low-contrast grey buttons for navigation.
- **Destructive/Critical Action:** Background `#FFFFFF`, text `#B56D29`, 1.5px border `#B56D29`.

### Chips & Badges
- **Status Tag (Approved/Active):** Background `#E8EFE6`, text `#183C32`, 1px border `#DDE4DA`, border-radius `9999px`, padding `0.25rem 0.75rem`.
- **Attention Tag (Required Action):** Background `#FFF7EE`, text `#B56D29`, 1px border `rgba(181, 109, 41, 0.25)`, border-radius `9999px`.
- **Category Filter Chip:** Unselected: `#FFFFFF` with 1px border `#DDE4DA`; Selected: `#256653` with text `#FFFFFF`.

### Conversational Cards
- Container built with `#FFFFFF` background, 1px solid border `#DDE4DA`, and `12px` border-radius.
- Cards feature explicit vertical padding (`1.5rem`) and distinct internal sections separated by 1px rules.
- Card titles utilize `Newsreader` (20px or 24px) in `#183C32`.

### Form Fields & Inputs
- **Base Style:** Minimum height 48px, background `#FFFFFF`, border 1.5px solid `#DDE4DA`, border-radius 8px, typography `Noto Sans` (16px), color `#183C32`.
- **Active Focus:** Border transitions to `#256653` with a 1px solid `#256653` outer ring (no hazy glowing blue box-shadows).
- **Helper & Validation Labels:** Persistent placement below the field. Error text in `#B56D29` paired with an icon; never communicate state with color alone.

### Selection Controls (Radio & Checkbox)
- Custom circular radios and rounded checkboxes with 22px × 22px frame for touch accessibility.
- Selected state fills with `#256653` displaying a crisp white mark.
- Group options are rendered inside distinct card-row containers with 1px border `#DDE4DA`, making tap zones large and explicit.

### Specialized Public Service Components
- **Document Checklist Item:** A two-part component featuring document title in English & Kannada, validity criteria, and a two-state switch ("I have this" / "I need help obtaining this").
- **Official Office Card:** Details field officer title, jurisdiction bounds, office physical hours, and direct official landline/complaint portal link.
- **Language Switcher Strip:** Sticky, high-contrast banner allowing immediate one-tap switching between Kannada, English, and Hindi, persisting across the user journey.","theme":{"colorMode":"LIGHT","font":"NEWSREADER","roundness":"ROUND_EIGHT","customColor":"#256653","headlineFont":"NEWSREADER","bodyFont":"NOTO_SANS","labelFont":"NOTO_SANS","namedColors":{"on_tertiary_fixed_variant":"#6d3900","secondary_container":"#dbe2d9","on_secondary_fixed_variant":"#414942","error_container":"#ffdad6","outline":"#707974","secondary":"#596059","on_primary_fixed":"#002118","surface_tint":"#296956","outline_variant":"#bfc9c3","on_primary_fixed_variant":"#06513f","on_surface":"#002018","error":"#ba1a1a","surface_container":"#cff6e8","surface":"#e6fff4","primary_fixed":"#aef0d7","secondary_fixed":"#dde4dc","on_surface_variant":"#404945","on_tertiary_container":"#ffc99f","surface_dim":"#bbe2d4","surface_container_highest":"#c4ebdc","surface_container_lowest":"#ffffff","on_secondary_fixed":"#171d18","background":"#e6fff4","on_secondary":"#ffffff","primary":"#004e3c","surface_container_high":"#c9f1e2","surface_variant":"#c4ebdc","primary_fixed_dim":"#93d4bc","on_error":"#ffffff","secondary_fixed_dim":"#c1c8c0","on_primary":"#ffffff","inverse_on_surface":"#d2f9ea","tertiary_fixed":"#ffdcc2","on_primary_container":"#a0e1c9","primary_container":"#256653","on_secondary_container":"#5d645d","tertiary_container":"#8b4b04","on_background":"#002018","tertiary_fixed_dim":"#ffb77c","inverse_surface":"#12362d","tertiary":"#693700","surface_container_low":"#d5fced","on_error_container":"#93000a","inverse_primary":"#93d4bc","surface_bright":"#e6fff4","on_tertiary_fixed":"#2e1500","on_tertiary":"#ffffff"},"designMd":"---

## Brand & Style

This design system is crafted for public service delivery with a non-dashboard, high-dignity editorial disposition. It rejects the cold, telemetry-heavy aesthetics of SaaS dashboards and the flashy, deceptive patterns of consumer tech. Instead, it positions civic interactions as thoughtful, patient conversations rooted in archival permanence and clarity.

### Core Tenets
- **Civic Dignity & Calm:** The UI treats every interaction—whether checking pension eligibility, downloading a land record (Bhoomi/RTC), or filing a civic grievance—with stillness and respect.
- **Editorial Legibility:** Layouts follow reading-first publication paradigms rather than widget-dense cockpits. Information unfolds sequentially rather than clamoring for simultaneous attention.
- **Rooted & Tactile:** Replaces synthetic drop shadows, neon accents, and artificial gradients with physical metaphors of heavy rag paper, deliberate ink-weights, and quiet border lines.

### Visual Style
A hybrid of **Warm Editorial Publishing** and **Structured Public-Sector Functionalism**. Visual structures rely on warm bone/paper backgrounds, deep green-tinted ink lettering, sharp informational hierarchy, and hairline dividing rules that echo printed gazettes and citizen charters.

## Colors

The palette is anchored in organic, civic materials: archival paper, botanical dyes, and deep vegetable ink.

### Semantic Color Assignments
- **Canvas / Paper (`#F8F7F2`):** The primary warm background. Never pure cold white (`#FFFFFF`). Eliminates eye fatigue in prolonged reading sessions and reinforces physical paper permanence.
- **Card Surface (`#FFFFFF`):** Reserved for elevated conversational containers, document stages, and interactive modular sheets.
- **Deep Forest Ink (`#183C32`):** Primary text color, authoritative headlines, and highest-contrast structural accents. Used instead of pure `#000000` to prevent harsh synthetic contrast.
- **Forest Primary (`#256653`):** Primary action triggers, key active links, verified checkmarks, and formal navigational state indicators.
- **Muted Green Pill/Accent (`#E8EFE6`):** Low-stress background for status pills, conversational question cards, category metadata, and active segment backgrounds.
- **Amber Civic Alert/Tag (`#B56D29`):** Grounded warm ochre for critical notices, mandatory document checklists, and pending processing statuses. Never shrill neon warning tones.
- **Subtle Warm Border (`#DDE4DA`):** Hairline structure for cards, dividers, field borders, and step indicators.
- **Muted Text (`#4E675E`):** Secondary metadata, timestamps, field hints, and non-blocking subtext. Maintains a compliant contrast ratio above 4.5:1 against both `#F8F7F2` and `#FFFFFF`.

Dark mode is deliberately omitted; public access kiosks, daylight outdoors usage, and printed readability take absolute priority.

## Typography

The typography system pairs the intellectual gravitas of an archival serif with the universal functional clarity of multilingual sans-serif type.

### Type Pairings & Script Harmonization
- **Headlines (`Newsreader`):** Provides a calm, deliberate literary tone reminiscent of printed state gazettes and historic publications. Used for page titles, conversational prompts, and major section intros.
- **Body & Controls (`Noto Sans`):** Selected for its flawless multi-script support across English, Kannada (`Noto Sans Kannada`), and Hindi (`Noto Sans Devanagari`). - **Active Focus:** Border transitions to `#256653` with a 1px solid `#256653` outer ring (no hazy glowing blue box-shadows).
- **Helper & Validation Labels:** Persistent placement below the field. Error text in `#B56D29` paired with an icon; never communicate state with color alone.

### Selection Controls (Radio & Checkbox)
- Custom circular radios and rounded checkboxes with 22px × 22px frame for touch accessibility.
- Selected state fills with `#256653` displaying a crisp white mark.
- Group options are rendered inside distinct card-row containers with 1px border `#DDE4DA`, making tap zones large and explicit.

### Specialized Public Service Components
- **Document Checklist Item:** A two-part component featuring document title in English & Kannada, validity criteria, and a two-state switch ("I have this" / "I need help obtaining this").
- **Official Office Card:** Details field officer title, jurisdiction bounds, office physical hours, and direct official landline/complaint portal link.
- **Language Switcher Strip:** Sticky, high-contrast banner allowing immediate one-tap switching between Kannada, English, and Hindi, persisting across the user journey.

screens.prompt:
Create the 'Forms Library' screen for MyGovGuide, 'Government Information, In Your Language'.

Design System & Visual Constraints:
- Calm Civic Editorial design system: warm paper background (#F8F7F2 / #FAF9F5), forest ink typography (#183C32), deep primary (#256653), soft sage container fills (#E8EFE6 / #EEF4ED), hairline borders (#DDE4DA), Noto Sans body typography with multilingual Kannada and Hindi label subtitles/fallbacks, restrained Newsreader serif headlines, 8px spacing grid, 12px card border radius, minimum 48px tactile interactive touch targets/controls.
- Citizen-service civic reference interface, NOT a commercial SaaS dashboard. Absolutely NO photographs, NO illustrations, NO glossy gradients, NO fake governmental seals or unverified live data.
- Include the exact top civic disclaimer banner: "Design Reference & Future Specification Example — Not An Approved Live Application | 100% Anonymous: Zero PII Collected".
- Consistent header with MyGovGuide logo (open book / civic emblem), tagline "ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಸರಳ ಭಾಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ / Government Information, In Your Language", top navigation links (Home, Explore, Forms Library [Active], How It Works), language switcher pill (EN / ಕನ್ನಡ / हिंदी), notification icon, profile icon.

Forms Library Screen Specifics:
1. Breadcrumbs: Civic Repository / Forms & Procedural Checklists (ದಾಖಲೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅರ್ಜಿ ನಮೂನೆಗಳು)
2. Screen Headline & Subheading:
   - Editorial serif title: "Civic Forms & Official Procedures Library"
   - Bilingual subtitle in Kannada: "ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಅರ್ಜಿ ನಮೂನೆಗಳು, ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ ಸೂಚಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶೀಲನಾ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳು"
   - Clear advisory note: "All downloadable templates and portal links are referenced directly from Karnataka and Union Gazettes. MyGovGuide does NOT host third-party forms or store citizen data."
3. Comprehensive Search & Filter Controls (48px height controls):
   - Primary search input: "Search forms by scheme name, form number, or citizen category (e.g. Nadakacheri, PMUY, Caste & Income, Bonafide)..." with keyboard shortcut hint.
   - Filter Chips (tactile pills):
     * Format / Action Type: [All Resources] [Downloadable Blank PDF Forms] [Official Application Portals] [Procedural Checklists & Instructions]
     * Citizen Group / Domain: [Student & Education] [Farmer / Agrarian] [Social Welfare & Subsidies] [Women & Child Development] [Healthcare & Energy]
     * Verification Status: [Gazette Audited] [Pending Research Review]
4. Research Integrity / Middleman Alert Banner:
   - "Citizen Caution: Government application forms and Seva Sindhu submissions are strictly statutory and free from administrative surcharges. Never pay unauthorized intermediaries or cyber cafe agents for blank standard forms."
5. Primary Form & Portal Directory Grid / List:
   Distinctly categorized with high visual clarity separating "Downloadable PDF Document", "Authenticated Portal Only", and "Procedural Instruction Guide":

   A) PM Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) - Supplementary KYC Annexure-I:
      - TYPE BADGE: "Authenticated Portal Link Only" (Highlighted with clear external boundary styling).
      - Note: "In accordance with safety and oil marketing company (OMC) compliance rules, PMUY KYC applications cannot be submitted via mirror forms. Directs strictly to the official Union MoPNG / PMUY authenticated portal (pmuy.gov.in)."
      - Kannada translation: "ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್ ಲಿಂಕ್ ಮಾತ್ರ — ಮಧ್ಯವರ್ತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಹಣ ನೀಡಬೇಡಿ."
      - Metadata: Central Sector • Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas • Gazette Citation: GSR-341(E) • Review Status: Gazette Verified (Dec 2024).
      - Action: "Open Official PMUY Portal (External .gov.in) [Icon: External Link]" + "View Required Identity Checklist".

   B) Nadakacheri Atalji Janasnehi Kendra - 14-Digit Caste & Income Certificate (Form 1 / Form 2):
      - TYPE BADGE: "Downloadable Offline Reference PDF + Online Portal Guide".
      - Description: "Standard statutory affidavit and self-declaration format for Tahsildar revenue verification in Karnataka (Cat-1/2A/2B/3A/3B/SC/ST)."
      - Kannada title: "ಆದಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಜಾತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಪತ್ರ (ನಮೂನೆ ೧ / ೨) - ನಡಕಚೇರಿ".
      - Metadata: Karnataka Revenue Department • 3 Pages (A4) • Format: Fillable Offline PDF (Bilingual Kannada/English).
      - Status: "Gazette Verified • Active Template 2024-25".
      - Action: "Download Standard PDF (A4 420KB)" and "Track on Nadakacheri Portal".

   C) Karnataka Post-Matric Fee Concession - Institutional Bonafide & AISHE Verification Voucher:
      - TYPE BADGE: "Institutional Submission Template".
      - Description: "Affidavit template to be certified and stamped by College Principal/Institutional Nodal Officer (INO) citing AISHE code for SSP portal DBT disbursal."
      - Kannada: "ಕಾಲೇಜು ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಮತ್ತು ಬೋನಾಫೈಡ್ ದೃಢೀಕರಣ ನಮೂನೆ".
      - Metadata: Dept of Backward Classes Welfare • 1 Page PDF • Requires Principal Stamp.
      - Action: "Download Form PDF" + "Step-by-step INO Verification Guide".

   D) Seva Sindhu Citizen Services Protocol - Domicile & Continuous Residency Affidavit:
      - TYPE BADGE: "Procedural Checklist & Standard Draft".
      - Description: "Required format for proving 7+ years continuous residency in Karnataka when standard school records have gaps."
      - Metadata: Karnataka Dept of Personnel & Administrative Reforms • Status: "Research Material (Pending Departmental Review)".
      - Notice Badge: "Pending Review / ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಬಾಕಿ - Consult Local Tahsildar Office Before Submitting".
      - Action: "Inspect Research Draft & Checklist".

   E) Senior Citizen Card & Sandhya Suraksha Pension Sanction Form (Form 4):
      - TYPE BADGE: "Downloadable Blank Form".
      - Description: "Application for age-linked welfare grant, including Village Accountant enquiry schedule."
      - Metadata: Directorate of Social Security and Pensions, Karnataka.
      - Action: "Download Blank Form (Kannada & English)".

6. "How to Identify an Authentic Government Portal" Sidebar/Section:
   - Visual guidance card detailing:
     * Check for `.gov.in` or `.nic.in` domains (never `.com`, `.org`, or unofficial `.in` blogs).
     * HTTPS security lock with valid National Informatics Centre (NIC) certificate.
     * Absence of ad banners, paid fast-track buttons, or private UPI payment gateways.
     * Official state contact number (1902 Janaspandana helpline).
7. Consistent calm civic footer with Citizen Charter, Official Gazette Archive, Kannada Helpdesk, and zero PII privacy guarantee.

All styles must use Tailwind CSS utility classes and clean semantic HTML, perfectly harmonious with Screen 2, 4, 5, 6, and 8.
